LanguageData.Gun_M1_Garand_RWP.description: The M1 Garand is a semi-automatic battle rifle, renowned for its reliability and accuracy. It fires .30-06 Springfield cartridges and is equipped with an 8-round en bloc clip. Ideal for medium-range engagements, it offers a balanced mix of stopping power and firing speed.
